metaTitle: Custom Sublimation Awards Recognition | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom sublimation awards recognition for vibrant, all-over color. Perfect for employee milestones and corporate events.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows for full-color, all-over designs that won't peel or fade, making it ideal for awards and recognition pieces that need to look pristine for years. Whether you're honoring a decade of service or a top sales achievement, sublimation delivers crisp logos, photos, and gradients directly into the surface of the award. This decoration method works best on polyester-coated or polymer materials, ensuring your custom sublimation awards recognition stands out in any office or ceremony setting.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation awards recognition plaque with full-color design and company logo
